eligibility_tiers.line: High school juniors and seniors are eligible. Students must have a high school GPA of 3.0, be a high school junior or senior, and meet the qualifying score on the SAT, ACT, CLT or ACCUPLACER test for certain courses they want to take.

Homeschool students are eligible. Students must have a high school GPA of 3.0, be a high school junior or senior, and meet the qualifying score on the SAT, ACT, CLT or ACCUPLACER test for certain courses they want to take.
